questions: How many samples, islands and vortices did you take full spectra on, and how many showed the ZBCP? Your abstract says "MZMs are observed in all measured vortices"; the count behind "all" would help readers.
Were any vortices or islands set aside (for example vortices near island edges or steps, or at higher field), and why?

Which fields, temperatures and tip setpoints did you measure beyond those shown? The captions of Fig. 3 and Fig. 4B-D don't give the field, and the vortex spectra in Figs. 2 and 3 don't give a temperature.
What do the spectra look like at your second-best vortex, and at each vortex in the two- and three-vortex configurations of Fig. 4B-D?

How were the five levels in Fig. 3G fitted? Your values give |L2/L1| of about 2.5 and |L-2/L-1| of about 2.3, between the integer ratio (2) and the half-odd-integer ratio (3), and the text gives a spacing of "about 0.7 meV" while the fitted spacings are about 0.8 to 0.9 meV and 1.2 meV. How does a half-integer fit compare at your resolution?

Did you measure the same core location at zero field, and does the core sit on an interstitial Fe or other defect in topography? The zero-field spectrum in Fig. 2I is "at clean surface", and the short, isotropic decay you report also describes the excess-Fe bound state of Yin et al.
How does the ZBCP height change with tip-sample distance? Fig. 3B-E use a 1 nA setpoint and the maps use 500 pA.
What are the fitted decay lengths along the white and orange arrows in Fig. 3H-I and for the Bi2Te3-derived states you compare them with, and did you measure other directions?
